content.comment_body: Hello! I would like to know the maximum cable length that can be used for analog outputs on the latest [product_name].
Hi, According to the [product_name] manual: For shielded and twisted cables, the maximum length is 10 meters.

Another participant provides a guideline from the [product_name] manual, stating that 10 meters is the maximum length for shielded and twisted cables. The discussion is clear and focused on technical specification.
